_doku: P1 (Codex review of #91, 04.11.2026): issuers whose shown market cap is the sum over their listed share classes, each class at its own close.

Read by lib/mcap-class-sum.js in the merge job (scripts/apply-mcap-class-sum.js): value = sum of shares x unadjusted close of the newest finished trading day on which every class and the FX pair of every class currency have a close (Yahoo daily chart), x that FX close. The value goes into the line the listing choice of the scoring (issuerDedupComparator) picks on the pull values; every other line the pull did not hold is emptied with a reason naming that line; held lines keep their hold.
No common finished close within 10 days, a class without closes, a chart in another currency, or no FX close of that day: the value is empty with a German reason, never a guess.

shares: issuer count of each class without treasury shares and without shares repurchased but not yet cancelled, with its own day (asOf) and source. currency: trading currency of the class. reviewBy: after it the merge log warns every run and the sum is still computed; re-verify the counts and move reviewBy.

The 16 share-count rows that froze the price ratio of 30.10.2026 into H or A equivalents are removed with this file (their counts and sources are copied below); the shadow registry configs/mcap-classes-registry.json is unchanged.
